detailed_description: The Polar Bar Chart Generator helps you turn small datasets into a radial bar chart directly in your browser. Use Load Sample or edit the default name/value rows, add or remove items, and adjust the chart title, color theme, inner radius, legend visibility, round caps, and stack mode. The ECharts preview updates from the current rows and settings, and the toolbar can export the rendered chart as PNG or SVG. The tool does not import CSV or JSON files, fetch live data, support per-bar styling, or run statistical analysis.
usage_steps: Click Load Sample or edit the default name and value rows.
Use Add Item or the row delete button to manage the data points.
Update the chart title and choose a color theme: default, ocean, sunset, or forest.
Adjust the inner radius slider and toggle legend visibility, round caps, or stack mode.
Review the ECharts preview and download the current chart as PNG or SVG.
usage_examples: Load the monthly sample data and export a radial bar chart for a presentation.
Turn a short list of category scores into a circular chart for documentation.
Compare the default, ocean, sunset, and forest themes before downloading an SVG.

faqs.question: Can I edit the data directly?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can add or remove rows and edit each row's name and numeric value before exporting the chart.

faqs.question: Which export formats are available?
faqs.answer: The chart can be exported as PNG or SVG from the buttons above the preview.

faqs.question: Does this connect to live data sources?
faqs.answer: No. The current tool uses manual rows and sample data in the browser.
